title: WatchFace (APPS Large) not right rendered after upgrade from AAPS 3.2.0.4 to AAPS 3.3.0
symptom: After upgrading from AAPS 3.2.0.4 to 3.3.0, the Custom WatchFace AAPS(Large) is not properly rendered. The white row ("MatchDivider") in the middle of the screen is not visible, and also the value inside the MatchDivider is not visible.
cause: The issue is due to a fresh install of Wear apk, causing the default values shown within watch for each parameter to be inconsistent with the value read within Custom WatchFace.
fix: Workaround: switch on then switch off each parameter of AAPS(Large) to get correct visibility of watchface. For the background and white bar: set Dark parameter enabled then disabled (or opposite), set matchdivider to enabled then disable (or opposite). In case of overlapping, manually change the value of "min ago", "Uploader Battery" and "Status information". The issue was fixed by commit 79edafef19110b7dfc00f39da7663303142140e1.
settings_changed: Dark parameter → enabled then disabled (or opposite)
